name: bootstrap-finite-standard-error
head: 703b11d0ac8e173bd258dfb80a13a1d1f5be7c15
title: Keep bootstrap standard errors finite across statistic scales
body:
### Description

`bootstrap` can return an infinite or zero standard error even when every replicate and the correct standard error are finite. Directly squaring large or small deviations overflows or underflows. For the same seeded mean bootstrap, scaling the sample by `1e200` changes a standard error near 0.77934 into `inf`, while scaling by `1e-200` changes it into zero.

The calculation now rescales finite replicates by a power of two, centers the bounded values, computes their standard deviation, and restores the scale. Centering also preserves small variations around a large common offset. Resampling, the original statistic, confidence-interval order statistics, and `ddof` keep their existing behavior; nonfinite replicate statistics retain the NumPy path.

### Related issues or pull requests

Closes #1323.

Deduplication covered the complete reachable history for the affected source across upstream PR refs and fork branches: 45 commits and 17 distinct versions all used the same direct standard-deviation calculation. No equivalent correction was found.

### Validation

- Exact upstream base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.
- **23 of 37 new regression cases fail on unchanged source**; all 37 pass with the change.
- A separate 100-digit Decimal variance calculation supplies the numerical oracle. Cases include positive and negative scales, subnormal statistics, finite results near the float limit, constant large statistics, narrow variation about large offsets, several degrees of freedom, undefined/nonfinite statistics, unchanged resampling, and unchanged percentile bounds.
- New and existing bootstrap tests: **40 passed**. Complete repository suite: **777 passed, 3 skipped**.
- Baseline and patch ran in the same job with Python 3.11.18 and the unchanged frozen lock.
- Complete repository isort/Black, changed-file Flake8, `git diff --check`, package build, and strict Twine checks passed. The repository-wide Flake8 report was collected with its existing findings; it is not presented as a clean lint gate.

[Baseline and complete validation evidence](https://github.com/Afloat16/geoopt/actions/runs/43884351861/job/133358329515).
